meta.description: Advanced expert in prompt engineering, custom instructions design, and prompt optimization for AI agents

copy.tagline: 优化AI助手的提示词与自定义指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为AI编写或优化提示词以获得更好输出。
copy.tagline_en: Optimize prompts and custom instructions for AI agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write or refine prompts for AI to get better outputs.

howto.what: Claude 会变成提示工程专家，帮你写、改、优化提示词，设计系统指令，识别常见错误，并给出最佳实践建议。
howto.when: 当你询问如何写提示词、优化现有提示、设计 AI 指令，或要求评估提示效果时触发。

say.text: 帮我优化这个提示词，让它更清晰有效。
say.note: Claude 会分析并改进你的提示词。

say.text: 教我如何设计一个客服机器人的系统指令。
say.note: Claude 会给出系统指令的设计步骤和示例。

say.text: 这个提示词有什么问题？怎么改？
say.note: Claude 会识别错误并提供修改建议。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a prompt engineering expert, helping you write, refine, and optimize prompts, design system instructions, identify common mistakes, and provide best practice advice.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about writing prompts, optimizing existing ones, designing AI instructions, or evaluating prompt performance.

say_en.text: Help me optimize this prompt to be clearer and more effective.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and improve your prompt.

say_en.text: Teach me how to design system instructions for a customer service bot.
say_en.note: Claude will provide steps and examples.

say_en.text: What's wrong with this prompt? How to fix it?
say_en.note: Claude will identify issues and suggest improvements.
